target_customer: Banks, lenders and fintechs in Mexico and Colombia that onboard businesses and originate mortgages and payroll loans
problem: Back-office checks such as KYB and mortgage underwriting depend on manual reading of deeds, powers of attorney and payslips, taking weeks.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API for document AI; pricing not found
product_category: Document AI for KYB and lending operations

founders.name: Fabian Torres
prior_employers: A fintech company (product team lead, unnamed on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he began in LatAm investments.

founders.name: Luis Sebastian Buitrago Leon
founders.background_notes: YC page says CFO of two family businesses and deployed real estate capital from $25M to $150M+.

competitors.name: Middesk
competitors.what: Business identity and KYB verification, US focused

competitors.name: Truora
competitors.what: LatAm identity and background verification with registry coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: OCR, extraction from Spanish legal documents and checks against national registries need document AI work and country by country integration.

defensibility.rationale: Registry integrations in Mexico and Colombia and bank workflows raise switching costs, though general document AI is copyable.

market_need_then: The QED Investors piece on LatAm compliance infrastructure argues informal SME economies need lighter KYB; this is later commentary, not dated near the batch.

branding.name_origin: Trebol is Spanish for clover; no source states why the founders chose it.
branding.domain_note: Uses gotrebol.com, a prefixed domain; no history found.

identity.logo: A catalog entry mentions a red all-caps TREBOL wordmark but it is not confirmed to be this company

brand_strength.rationale: A USPTO TREBOL mark from 2009 and many clover logos make the name common; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Trebol raised a $3M seed in 2023, grew to a team of 14 per YC, and names customers including Clara, Actinver, Banco Plata and Lulo Bank on its site, with ISO 27001 listed. That suggests a working enterprise sales motion in Mexico and Colombia, but no Series A or exit was found.
notes: Seed of $3M is reported by FF News and an Extruct profile (dated May 24, 2023 with the investors listed); direct fetch of the FF News page returned 404, so the date comes from the Extruct snippet. YC page says Winter 2022 and founded 2021. Competitor entries are not dated: Middesk from a CB Insights comparison, Truora from a competitor's marketing page.
